ability.name: Domain Controller and Pivot Evaluation Gate
ability.description: Inspects the collected subnet services, resolves local domain controller properties, and specifies transition pathways to subsequent phases based on directory services detection.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $dcIp = $null; $svcFile = 'C:\Windows\Temp\bas\services.json'; if (Test-Path $svcFile) { $svcs = Get-Content $svcFile | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach ($ip in $svcs.PSObject.Properties.Name) { $ports = $svcs.$ip | Select-Object -ExpandProperty port; if (($ports -contains 88) -and ($ports -contains 389 -or $ports -contains 636)) { $dcIp = $ip; break } } }; $domainJoined = $false; try { $cs = Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem; if ($cs.PartOfDomain) { $domainJoined = $true } } catch {}; if ($dcIp) { Write-Output "DC_FOUND: true"; Write-Output "DC_IP: $dcIp"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: ad-enumeration"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: false" } elseif ($domainJoined) { try { $dc = [System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectory.Domain]::GetCurrentDomain().DomainControllers[0]; $dcIp = $dc.IPAddress; Write-Output "DC_FOUND: true"; Write-Output "DC_IP: $dcIp"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: ad-enumeration"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: false" } catch { Write-Output "DC_FOUND: false"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: escalating-privileges"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: true" } } else { Write-Output "DC_FOUND: false"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: escalating-privileges"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: true" } } catch { Write-Output "DC_FOUND: false"; Write-Output "ERROR: step7 $($_.Exception.Message)"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: escalating-privileges" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\dc_gate.txt

rationale: An analytical check must confirm the presence of a reachable domain controller. When confirmed, Active Directory domain queries are unlocked, routing execution immediately to advanced AD-Enumeration (Phase B).
